outcome: Pregnancy-associated mortality rates (PMR) from all causes
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 33,417,736 hospital deliveries of females aged 15-54 years old identified from the Nationwide Readmissions Database (2010-2018).
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDPs) are strong risk factors for pregnancy-associated mortality due to cardiovascular disease (CVD) at delivery and within 1 year postpartum, with risks being stronger for stroke than for heart disease-related PMR.
